definitions.explanation: A tree that is notably large in size.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大木|たいぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large tree at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{樹齢|じゅれい}→樹齢：23245_jurei⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大木|たいぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A hundred-year-old large tree stands there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大木|たいぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。

examples.english: This large tree is treasured as a symbol of the town, and many people come to see it every year.

notes:
{大木|たいぼく} means a large tree — notably big in trunk, height, or canopy. It evokes impressive, mature trees rather than just any large one.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大木|たいぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: a large tree stands
- {大木|たいぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{倒|たお}す→切り倒す：28522_kiritaosu⟧: to fell a large tree
- ⟦{樹齢|じゅれい}→樹齢：23245_jurei⟧〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大木|たいぼく}: a tree aged ~ years

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{巨木|きょぼく}→巨木：17184_kyoboku⟧: giant tree (even larger, often awe-inspiring)
- ⟦{老木|ろうぼく}→老木：noentry⟧: old tree (emphasis on age)
- ⟦{樹木|じゅもく}→樹木：04955_jumoku⟧: tree (formal, general term)
- ⟦{御神木|ごしんぼく}→御神木：noentry⟧: sacred tree (at shrines/temples)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. In casual speech, ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (big tree) is more natural.
